D.t: Ami Bera leads by 27.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 69,366 votes; a one point swing is about 1,279 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +20.0 and D +34.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$1.7M cash against $27K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
